CustomField.label: Advanced: Found Summary Text
CustomField.description: Optional. Overrides the auto-generated "N of M records did not pass" Found line on a multi-row (Every record must pass) query check. Supports the count tokens {!failCount} and {!totalCount} plus {!FieldName} record tokens. Example: {!failCount} of {!totalCount} contacts missing email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional friendly wording for the Found line on a multi-row check. Use {!failCount} and {!totalCount}, for example: {!failCount} of {!totalCount} contacts missing email.
